name: 63376 · Saint Peters, MO
findings: ZIP 63376 (Saint Peters) has 218 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63376 (Saint Peters) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
